metadata.dataset_name: Ingaze Synthetic Multi-Channel Analytics & Sector Benchmark Snapshots
metadata.status: 100% optional quantitative companion dataset (see docs/ANALYTICS_TELEMETRY_DICTIONARY.md for metric definitions and scales)
metadata.description: Field-calibrated synthetic HR, public reputation, career portal funnel, social/advocacy, and hiring telemetry for the 11 historical B2B case studies (sector_peer_benchmarks, t0_before_intervention, t1_after_12_months) and the 3 active company scenarios (sector_peer_benchmarks, t0_current_snapshot). All schemas and metric scales are uniform across records (see docs/ANALYTICS_TELEMETRY_DICTIONARY.md). Teams may use these tables to ground causal diagnoses, compare company metrics against sector norms, run standalone statistical/quantitative models, or ignore this file altogether.
